name: Yaritza A. Gonzalez
office: Inglewood Unified School District, Member, Board of Education, Trustee Area 3

items.text: Yaritza A. Gonzalez is a policy manager at the Central American Resource Center (CARECEN-LA). She co-founded the ING Fellowship. She earned a bachelor's degree from Dartmouth College and a Master of Public Policy from the UCLA Luskin School of Public Affairs.

sentences.text: Yaritza A. Gonzalez is a policy manager at the Central American Resource Center (CARECEN-LA).
She earned a bachelor's degree from Dartmouth College and a Master of Public Policy from the UCLA Luskin School of Public Affairs.

items.text: If the district regains local control, she says her top priorities are financial stability and student-centered governance. She supports paying teachers, keeping schools open, and creating safe schools by addressing immigration enforcement and displacement. She supports the Inglewood for All Act to provide sanctuary city protections.
